cases.name: Lindha Paola Zerpa Lara
cases.about:
She was an entrepreneur, and active member of the Venezuelan community in Utah. “She was always a bright light for her mom. A person that was always trying to do the best for their community, the Venezuelan community,” (family friend Patricia) Quinonez said. Paola immigrated to Utah from Venezuela 8 years ago; she trained as an esthetician, opened her own business, and helped organize We All Must Shine, a support organization for people going through cancer.

She opened a med spa in 2022, but just two months ago her business space burned to the ground and she was working to rebuild.
